title: Pickleball star Anna Leigh Waters sets Manila return for celebrity showdown
summary: Pickleball star Anna Leigh Waters is returning to the Philippines on Dec. 9, this time for a celebrity showdown with Piolo Pascual and Dingdong Dantes at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.
